channel.title: Road Wars
channel.desc: A near miss during a lane change in Michigan triggers a hard-hitting showdown. A Florida biker riding without tags has a run-in with police. Drivers on a highway in England try to help corral a swerving car. An automatic car wash in China goes rogue. In Utah, an attempt to steer clear of a roadside pullover has devastating effects.
